title: EduFair-Bench: Evaluating Pedagogical Fairness of LLM Tutors Across Student Demographics

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating educational dialogues with LLM tutors by explicitly stating student gender in prompts or implicitly using gender-connoted names, and comparing pedagogical quality metrics (e.g., scaffolding, tone). Also tests mismatched gender conditioning (Opposite condition).

Simulating educational dialogues by explicitly prompting the LLM tutor with the student's immigration background (native-born vs. immigrant) and measuring differences in pedagogical behavior using statistical tests.
Simulating educational dialogues by explicitly providing the student's first language status (English L1 vs. non-English L1) in the prompt and evaluating variations in tutoring quality.
Simulating educational dialogues by explicitly defining the student's socioeconomic status (low-income, middle-class, high-income) in the prompt and analyzing the tutor's pedagogical responses.

Using counterfactual name substitution with demographically connoted names (e.g., Western vs. Asian names) in the implicit condition prompt to evaluate whether implicit cues trigger differential tutoring behavior.
